items.title: M1 freeze Authority vocabulary migration contract
items.context: Create a source-of-truth migration/retirement document that defines banned active vocabulary, replacement local assurance/admissibility terms, and explicit legacy whitelist rules. Verification must prove the contract exists and is referenced by the scanner.
items.userSees: User sees the migration contract and scanner policy name the banned active Authority vocabulary and replacement local assurance/admissibility terms.

happy.desc: Migration contract exists and defines banned active terms plus replacement local assurance/admissibility vocabulary.

edge.desc: Contract distinguishes active surfaces from explicit legacy whitelist so historical docs can exist without weakening the active scanner.

adversarial.desc: A scanner or smoke must reference the contract so the document is not prose-only and cannot be bypassed at DONE.

items.title: M2 clean user-facing Authority wording
items.context: Update README, guide/docs, agent prompts/templates, CLI help/catalog text, DONE/user-facing output language so active surfaces no longer say Authority Server or productionDone-style no-overclaim wording; use local assurance/admissibility/evidence scope terms instead.

items.title: M3 remove Authority command surface from active CLI
items.context: Remove authority_* active commands from help/catalog/config and hide/delete legacy compatibility surfaces. Verification must inspect CLI help/catalog/config, not just source text.

items.title: M4 remove or quarantine server-backed Authority code and smokes
items.context: Delete or isolate server-backed authority client/runner/receipt-gate modules and corresponding smoke tasks. Preserve local quorum_submit, proof-admissibility, receipt-bundle, delivery-check, and local lifecycle gates.

items.title: M5 add hard retired-Authority scanner gate
items.context: Add a hard scanner/smoke that fails if active core code or active docs contain Authority Server, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, or LATTICE_AUTHORITY_* outside explicit legacy/migration whitelist. This scanner must be part of validation so DONE cannot pass with drift.
